extensions.org.licoland.adapter.codex/purpose: The Codex adapter: the app-server driver and the vendor protocol that classifies one app-server JSON-RPC line exactly once below the adapter port, plus the Subagent MCP caller registration an installed Codex client uses. The kernel owns no part of Codex and depends on none of it.
extensions.org.licoland.adapter.codex/persistentDat: This package declares no conversion because it owns no persisted package data of its own: it writes no data home, no cache and no store. The Codex rollout records it reads belong to the installed Codex client, and the client's own conversation store remains the kernel's.
